messages:
alina: Tiny request: can we add a 'Lite device' example to Optimize that shows batching+cache+quant for tiny VMs? Avoid heavy knobs, just one copy-paste Python snippet. I'll open PR.
pete: +1. Customers keep asking for a low-footprint recipe. Keep it minimal and say "best-effort" about quality.
rahul: I have a short quant profile we can recommend for small GPUs (q4_0-ish) and an int8 fallback. I'll paste both.
claire: FYI linkcheck already flagged `/optimize/legacy/quant` in main, that's probably the old anchor. We should add a redirect and update cross-links in the SDK examples.
alina: Draft Python snippet (for docs/examples/sdk/py):
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(
  model='redwood/mini-compact-v1',
  input='Explain the core idea of this paragraph in one line.',
  batching={'max_batch_tokens':512},
  cache={'mode':'prefix'},
  quant_profile='q4_0_lite'
)
print(resp.text)
```
rahul: Quant profile drafts:
- q4_0_lite: type=q4_0, prefer_speed=True, kv_cache_shrink=0.5
- int8_fallback: type=int8, prefer_speed=False, maintain_fp_residual=True
(We can put those as a YAML code block in docs with a short note on tradeoffs.)
pete: Can we also add a 2-line note under "When to use" that says: "Use Lite on constrained infra; expect small quality delta vs full precision, but big memory savings."
claire: I'll add a redirect from `/optimize/legacy/quant` -> `/optimize/quantization/profiles` in the PR. Also will grep the repo for old links and fix a couple.
alina: I'll include a minimal smoke test: 3 prompts and expected substring matches (very loose). That prevents silly regressions.
rahul: Also add a single eval metric (bleu-ish or exact-match) note: "run eval after merge; threshold=0.92 vs baseline" — keeps it concrete.
pete: Who's taking the PR?
alina: I'll open it now and tag you both. PR will be small: snippet + quant YAML + redirect + smoke tests + one-line migration note.
docs-bot: PR created: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1278> by alina (docs: optimize - lite device example + quant redirects)
claire: Running local linkcheck and smoke tests. Will ping when staging deploy is up.
alina: Thanks. If staging passes, we'll merge after one review. :thankyou:
